# Frozen code-maintenance installation fixtures

Captured on 4 November 2026 from isolated installations using the published
`v0.4.0-alpha.1` macOS ARM64 client, SHA-256
`1e26906d6f2e7fba2b3807953683a47f9caa5b6e59db15c41bc5f3ec08f9f34e`.
The exact plugin archive is `engineering/code-maintenance-plugin@0.2.0`, SHA-256
`7d170bcd18bb15c58eacd99fc8a0def78498ca795e62eae9fc951301b308f93a`.

The registration documents and receipt templates are frozen output from that
released client. Tests reconstruct installations from the retained archive,
these documents and independently recomputed receipt tree hashes. They do not
use the current compiler or checker to calculate expected registration output.
The five required skills are independently fixed in the tests and checker; the
fixture's submitted membership cannot define its own completeness.

Receipt timestamps record that capture, not an expiry or compatibility limit.
These fixtures prove no actual application discovery, hook enforcement or merge
authority.
